title: Junior Contracts Administrator
abstract: Join Com Built, the construction arm of Sydney Tools, and grow your career in construction contract administration.
bullets: Work across contracts, procurement, budgets and project delivery
Competitive salary, weekly pay and free onsite parking

content_text:
About Us:
 Com Built is the construction arm of Sydney Tools, one of Australia's leading tools and equipment retailers.
 We are seeking a motivated Junior Contracts Administrator to join our growing construction team.
 Immediate start available for the right candidate.
 About the Role:
 Working alongside our Project Managers, you will assist with contract administration, procurement, budgets and project documentation across multiple construction projects.
 This is a hands-on opportunity for someone with commercial construction experience looking to further develop their career.
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities:
 - Prepare and administer subcontractor packages and agreements.
 - Coordinate tenders, quotations and procurement.
 - Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and stakeholders.
 - Monitor project budgets, expenditure and cash flow.
 - Process progress claims, invoices and contract variations.
 - Assist with project scheduling, cost reporting and forecasting.
 - Prepare purchase orders, bills of quantities and material orders.
 - Coordinate development applications and building approvals.
 - Maintain project documentation and contract records.
 - Support Project Managers across multiple projects.
 About You:
 To be successful in this role, you will have:
 - Minimum 2 years' experience in commercial construction or contract administration.
 - Exposure to commercial, industrial, mixed-use or similar construction projects (advantageous).
 - Understanding of construction contracts, procurement and project budgets.
 - Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
 - Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
 - Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
 - A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
 - Full Australian working rights.
 Qualifications in Construction Management, Building or Quantity Surveying will be highly regarded.
 What's on Offer?
 - Competitive salary, negotiable depending on experience.
 - Permanent, full-time employment.
 - Weekly pay and free onsite parking at Roselands.
 - Exposure to multiple construction projects.
 - Career development and progression opportunities.
 - Supportive team of experienced construction professionals.
 How to Apply:
 If you have relevant construction experience and are looking to develop your career in contract administration, we'd like to hear from you.
 Apply now with your updated resume.
